def: A graph of the features, input tokens and error terms that contributed to one output on one prompt, computed on a replacement model whose MLPs are swapped for transcoders.
practice: The output of circuit tracing; Anthropic open-sourced tools in May 2025 that generate them for open models such as Gemma 2 2B and Llama 3.2 1B, explorable on Neuronpedia.
